_about: Corrections to the projection of the plan into tasks.json and TASKS.md, applied by
scripts/plan/extract-plan.py after it extracts each task. The plan document is
external and unchanged; where a later record (a specification change, a decision,
or the normative specification itself) supersedes what a task's text says, the
projection says what is now true, and names the record. Each amendment replaces
text the extraction produces exactly; the generator fails if that text is gone,
so an amendment cannot outlive what it corrects. Live file: edited, not generated.

P0-04.to: pre-commit hook script; the `cargo vet` supply-chain store `supply-chain/` with the tool's version pinned (`scripts/cargo-vet.sh`), checked by `make vet` in `ci.yml`, `nightly.yml` and `release.yml` (Part 5.12, which no task delivered: issue 36).

P2-04.to: keyed by `(engine_version, language_matrix_version, secret_policy_digest, language_id, rel_path, blob_sha)`, `blob_sha` of the original bytes, as specification 4.5 requires; only clean extractions cached (not truncated, no `extraction_lost`), and no cache while an engine extraction switch such as the node budget is set (issue 26, resolved)
